cityWorld.representation: OSM footprint extrusions; procedural surface detail, not photorealism

limitations: Direct Node WebGL, not browser UI automation or macOS validation.
WebGL1 adapter: browser WebGL2 feature output and performance may differ.
HDR loader uses spherical harmonics and ordinary mipmaps when WebGL1 cannot prefilter radiance.
No FPS claim; renderWallMs includes scene construction, compilation and capture.
No HTML HUD is included: this captures the actual 3D engine scene only.
